<project>/node_modules/@expo/log-box/ExpoLogBox.podspec: `s.compiler_flags = extraCompilerFlags` cannot be evaluated: it uses `extraCompilerFlags`, which is assigned `'$(inherited)' \
    + (isDevelop ? " -DEXPO_DEVELOP_LOG_BOX" : "") \
    + (isDebug ? " -DEXPO_DEBUG_LOG_BOX" : "") \
    + (isEnabled ? " -DEXPO_UNSTABLE_LOG_BOX" : "")`, which the reader cannot evaluate (`\` where it ends). The podspec reader evaluates locals, string interpolation, arrays, ENV['...'], package.json reads, comparisons, ternaries and if/unless blocks; building from the part it could read would leave some of the library's files or settings out of its target. Install Ruby (sudo apt install ruby) so rn-xtool reads the podspec as CocoaPods does, or give the library a Package.swift of its own.
